text_fragment_surface_label: Example quoted-text deep-link posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded review surface for browser-generated, search-generated, bookmarked, or user-shared highlighted-text deep links that may land on official voter-information pages.

reviewed_text_fragment_routes.context_posture: Highlighted text remains adjacent to the page heading, jurisdiction identity, and the current official help lane.
reviewed_text_fragment_routes.durability_posture: Maintained section anchors and citation-safe references remain the preferred durable official links for later handoff.
reviewed_text_fragment_routes.fail_open_recovery: If the highlighted text does not match or is not processed, the top-of-page heading and in-page navigation still make the controlling section easy to re-find.

reviewed_text_fragment_routes.context_posture: Quoted-text highlights are treated as convenience arrivals, not as standalone official record objects.
reviewed_text_fragment_routes.durability_posture: The office prefers share-safe canonical links and citation-safe deadline notices for durable forwarding.
reviewed_text_fragment_routes.fail_open_recovery: If the highlight is missing, the page still exposes the current deadline heading and official contact/recovery lane.

excerpt_context_integrity_note: Highlighted excerpts are reviewed so the surrounding page title, section heading, jurisdiction scope, freshness cues, and help lane remain visible enough to keep the excerpt trustworthy.
durable_anchor_preference_note: Quoted-text deep links are treated as convenience pointers; maintained section anchors, share-safe canonical URLs, and citation-safe heads remain the preferred durable official anchors when exactness or longevity matters.
unsupported_or_no_match_recovery_note: If the text fragment is unsupported, suppressed, or no longer matches, the route fails open with clear section/refinding cues instead of implying exact-quote recovery.
fragment_visibility_boundary_note: Public messaging does not overclaim that ordinary page scripts or server logs can directly read and certify the exact incoming text-fragment directive.
bookmark_share_propagation_note: Browser-generated bookmarks or shares carrying a highlight are reviewed as user-agent convenience handoffs rather than as office-issued portable records.
highlight_subordination_note: Highlighted text remains visibly subordinate to the current official page context rather than becoming the only realistic authority cue on screen.
